name: Europe hybrid attacks
value: GRU-ordered arson plot foiled, Estonia 14 Nov
summary: Estonia says Russia's GRU commissioned the foiled 14 Nov sabotage of drone maker Threod; eight suspects detained
state: Estonia's foreign minister said on 15 Nov there was clear evidence Russia's GRU ordered an attempted sabotage attack on drone maker Threod Systems in Viimsi, near Tallinn, on 14 Nov; eight suspects were detained and five remain in custody (Newsweek). Estonia earlier blamed Russia for an arson attack on robotics firm Milrem (Defense News, 29 Sep). No sabotage causing casualties or repeated multi-country shutdowns was found as of 18 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Report suspicious activity near infrastructure to local police. In the UK, follow police and MI5 guidance on staying alert.
rubric_hit: Sabotage attributed to a state = Watch; no casualties or major outage

sources.title: Newsweek — NATO member Estonia to shut Russia border roads after sabotage attack

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
